_note: Original Reelscore synopses, written in our own words. The build adds each one to its title only when the database has no synopsis, so an admin edit always wins. Keys are title ids.
nanhey: Raghu, the bright son of a Mumbai dhobi, gets a seat at an elite school when its principal (Suniel Shetty) bets on his potential. Surrounded by children from wealthy homes, he has to get past his own fear of not belonging, and finds his footing through six unlikely friendships. A children's drama about equal chances.
pratap: Pratap (Amit Sadh), a decorated encounter specialist, finds himself framed for murder by the very system he served. On the run from his former colleagues, he tries to expose the conspiracy behind his arrest while his wife Poonam (Esha Deol) holds the family together.
ranabaali: Set during the famine of the 1870s, this period action drama follows Ranabaali (Vijay Deverakonda), a rebel from a starving village who rises against British colonial rule. Rashmika Mandanna plays Jayamma, and Arnold Vosloo the British officer he must face, in a story inspired by forgotten history.
avaraachan-and-sons: Avaraachan (Biju Menon) is a widowed, hard-drinking father whose antics have embarrassed his grown children for years. When one of his misadventures blows up at home, his sons take him off to a hill-country hideout, where romance, village scuffles and an overdue growing-up await. A family comedy.
sigma: Guru (Sundeep Kishan), buried in debt and betrayed by people he trusted, throws himself into a high-stakes heist tied to a huge drugs-and-gambling racket. Jason Sanjay's first film as director mixes treasure-hunt adventure, action and comedy.
baththa: North Chennai, 1986. Baththa (Vijay Sethupathi), a feared local thug, ends up locked inside a deserted school toilet by an eight-year-old boy. Stuck there, the tough man's image starts to come apart, in a warm comedy-drama about rage, kindness and change.
dorothy: In a village in early-1990s Tamil Nadu, childhood friends Karthi and Subbu grow up inside a world of rigid ideas about manhood. When Subbu's elder brother returns home with a wife, Dorothy (Keerthy Suresh), her arrival unsettles the household and the friendship. Karthik Subbaraj's drama is based on real events, with music by Ilaiyaraaja.
meesaya-murukku-2: Hiphop Tamizha Adhi continues his semi-autobiographical story, playing three roles across two timelines, 1980s Madras and the present. Three generations of a North Chennai family fight for a place for their independent and gaana music against a closed, classical-minded establishment.
the-paradise: In 1980s Secunderabad, a man (Nani) returns from prison to a settlement called Paradise and is drawn into his mother's fight for their oppressed community's dignity and land. Srikanth Odela's violent period action drama reunites the Dasara team.
daayra: A police officer is hailed as a hero after four men accused of a rape and murder are killed in an encounter. Daayra follows two officers on opposite sides of what happened next, DCP Raman Kumar (Prithviraj Sukumaran) and DCP Ajooni Kohli (Kareena Kapoor Khan), asking where justice ends and vigilantism begins.
vibe: Best friends Hardik (Kunal Kemmu) and Bugs (Sparsh Shrivastava) go from a disastrous date to an accidental undercover mission for the mysterious Madam H (Preity Zinta), one that takes them from Mumbai to Bangkok. Kunal Kemmu writes and directs this spy comedy.
aasha: Aasha (Urvashi), an anxious single mother of two daughters, gets into a late-night road accident with a volatile pickup driver (Joju George). What starts as a roadside scuffle becomes a bitter legal fight that pulls in her daughter (Aishwarya Lekshmi) and keeps shifting who seems to be in the right.
pradhama-drishtiya-kutta: A young constable, Aleena (Parvathy Thiruvothu), who joined the force after her husband's death, and three junior colleagues find themselves on the wrong side of a crime. As a seasoned investigator (Vijayaraghavan) closes in, the officers try to cover their tracks in a police procedural told from the cops' side.
mandaadi: On the Tamil Nadu coast, Muthukaali (Soori), a gifted sailboat racer who walked away from the sport and his past, is pulled back into the traditional sea races, and into a bitter rivalry with his former friend Sattapuli (Suhas).
sardar-2: RAW agent Vijay Prakash (Karthi) takes on a mission tied to his father Chandra Bose, the legendary spy Sardar, and to an old operation. The trail leads to a villain (S. J. Suryah) whose scheme turns on medicines and biological warfare. Karthi plays both father and son.
i-m-game: Dan John (Dulquer Salmaan) is a businessman and compulsive gambler who trusts luck over everything else. After a severe accident, an unexpected supernatural twist turns his life into something closer to a fantasy action ride. From Nahas Hidhayath, the director of RDX.
romanchakam: Anvesh (Sumanth Prabhas), an aspiring start-up founder in Hyderabad, builds a dating app with his friends and falls for Mythili (Ananthika Sanilkumar) from Chennai. When she suddenly goes missing, the friends land in a mess of comic and tense trouble.
modha-rathri: Maruthanayagam and Muthuselvi (Rishikanth and Anishma Anilkumar) want nothing to do with marriage, but family pressure gets them married anyway. Their eventful wedding night, and the conversations it forces, drive this rural comedy about two reluctant strangers.
khalifa: Aamir Ali (Prithviraj Sukumaran), heir to a family with a long history in gold smuggling, lives in the UK with revenue intelligence officers on his trail. Pulled into the family business, he has to live up to the legend of his grandfather in Vysakh's action thriller, which also features a Mohanlal appearance.
vishwanath-and-sons: Sanjay Vishwanath (Suriya), a wealthy industrialist and Olympic shooter in his forties, is determined to stay single, but wants to give his mother (Radikaa Sarathkumar) an heir, so he turns to surrogacy. Things get complicated when he has to find the young surrogate (Mamitha Baiju) again.
sholay-1975: A retired police officer (Sanjeev Kumar) hires two small-time crooks, Jai (Amitabh Bachchan) and Veeru (Dharmendra), to capture the bandit Gabbar Singh (Amjad Khan), who destroyed his family. In the village of Ramgarh, the pair find friendship, love and a fight bigger than they bargained for.
dilwale-dulhania-le-jayenge-19: Raj (Shah Rukh Khan) and Simran (Kajol), two young Indians raised in London, fall in love on a trip across Europe. When Simran's strict father takes her to Punjab for an arranged marriage, Raj follows, determined to win her family's blessing rather than elope.
lagaan-2001: In a drought-hit village in 1893, farmer Bhuvan (Aamir Khan) accepts a British officer's challenge: beat his men at cricket and the village is spared its crushing tax for three years; lose and it pays triple. The villagers have to learn a game they have never played.
3-idiots-2009: Two friends set out to find Rancho (Aamir Khan), their brilliant, rule-breaking roommate from engineering college, who vanished after graduation. Through flashbacks of their years under a tyrannical director, the film takes aim at rote learning and pressure to succeed.
dangal-2016: Mahavir Singh Phogat (Aamir Khan), a former wrestler who never won gold for India, trains his daughters Geeta and Babita in a sport reserved for men, against the mockery of their village. Based on the true story of the Phogat sisters.
pk-2014: An alien (Aamir Khan) lands in Rajasthan and loses the remote he needs to go home. Searching for it, he runs into the business of religion, and with a journalist's help (Anushka Sharma) asks the questions no one else will.
baahubali-the-beginning-2015: Raised by villagers below a giant waterfall, Shivudu (Prabhas) climbs it and discovers the kingdom of Mahishmati, a captive queen, and the truth about his own birth. The first part of S. S. Rajamouli's epic.
baahubali-2-the-conclusion-201: The story of Amarendra Baahubali (Prabhas), his love for princess Devasena (Anushka Shetty) and the betrayal that cost him the throne, before his son rises to reclaim Mahishmati from Bhallaladeva (Rana Daggubati). The conclusion of Rajamouli's two-part epic.
k-g-f-chapter-1-2018: Rocky (Yash), raised on the streets of Bombay with a promise to his dying mother to become rich and powerful, is sent into the Kolar Gold Fields to kill its ruler, and finds thousands of enslaved workers there. The first part of Prashanth Neel's saga.
k-g-f-chapter-2-2022: Now master of the Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky (Yash) has to hold his empire against the brutal Adheera (Sanjay Dutt) and a determined prime minister (Raveena Tandon). The second chapter of Prashanth Neel's saga.
rrr-2022: In 1920s India, the tribal guardian Bheem (N. T. Rama Rao Jr.) comes to Delhi to rescue a girl taken by a British governor, and the police officer Ram (Ram Charan) is assigned to catch him. Unaware of each other's missions, the two become close friends. A fictional story built around two real revolutionaries.
jailer-2023: Muthuvel Pandian (Rajinikanth), a mild retired jailer living quietly with his family, is drawn back into violence when his police-officer son crosses an idol-smuggling gang. The grandfather everyone underestimates turns out to have a dangerous past.
vikram-2022: Officer Amar (Fahadh Faasil) investigates a string of killings by masked men targeting a drug network, and the trail leads to an elderly man everyone thought dead (Kamal Haasan). Lokesh Kanagaraj's action thriller ties into the world of his earlier film Kaithi.
drishyam-2013: Georgekutty (Mohanlal), a cable-TV operator obsessed with films, uses everything he has learned from cinema to protect his family when his wife and daughter are caught up in a death. A police inspector who is also the victim's mother will not let it go.
drishyam-2015: Vijay Salgaonkar (Ajay Devgn), a cable operator in Goa who has learned everything from films, protects his wife and daughter after a young man's death, while a determined senior police officer (Tabu), the boy's mother, hunts for the truth. Remake of the Malayalam original.
pushpa-the-rise-2021: Pushpa Raj (Allu Arjun), a daily-wage labourer in the forests of the Seshachalam hills, rises fast through the syndicate that smuggles red sanders, making powerful enemies on the way. Part one of Sukumar's saga.
pushpa-2-the-rule-2024: Now at the top of the red sandalwood smuggling trade, Pushpa (Allu Arjun) expands his empire and takes on political power, while the vengeful officer Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat (Fahadh Faasil) waits for his chance. The second part of Sukumar's saga.
deewaar-1975: Two brothers grow up on opposite sides of the law: Vijay (Amitabh Bachchan) becomes a powerful smuggler, while Ravi (Shashi Kapoor) joins the police. Their mother is caught between them in Yash Chopra's crime drama.
zanjeer-1973: Inspector Vijay (Amitabh Bachchan), haunted by the murder of his parents, takes on a powerful crime boss with the help of a street-smart knife sharpener (Jaya Bhaduri) and a Pathan with a code of honour (Pran). The film that made Amitabh Bachchan the 'angry young man'.
kabhi-khushi-kabhie-gham-2001: Rahul (Shah Rukh Khan), the adopted son of a wealthy patriarch (Amitabh Bachchan), is cast out when he marries Anjali (Kajol) against his father's wishes. Years later his younger brother (Hrithik Roshan) sets out to bring him home. Karan Johar's family drama.
kuch-kuch-hota-hai-1998: Before she died, Tina left letters for her eight-year-old daughter, asking her to reunite Rahul (Shah Rukh Khan) with Anjali (Kajol), his tomboyish best friend from college who loved him in silence. Karan Johar's first film.
chak-de-india-2007: Kabir Khan (Shah Rukh Khan), a disgraced former hockey captain, takes on the Indian women's hockey team, a squad divided by region and ego, and sets out to make them a team that can win the World Cup.
swades-2004: Mohan Bhargav (Shah Rukh Khan), a NASA scientist, returns to India to find the woman who raised him. In a small village he sees poverty and caste up close, and starts to question where he belongs.
taare-zameen-par-2007: Eight-year-old Ishaan struggles at school and is sent to boarding school, where he grows withdrawn. A new art teacher (Aamir Khan) recognises that he has dyslexia and helps him find his gift.
rang-de-basanti-2006: A British filmmaker casts a group of carefree Delhi students in a film about India's freedom fighters. When a friend dies because of official corruption, the roles they are playing start to shape what they do next.
andaz-apna-apna-1994: Two small-time dreamers, Amar (Aamir Khan) and Prem (Salman Khan), compete to marry a rich heiress, only to stumble into a kidnapping plot and a gallery of oddball villains. A cult comedy.
hum-aapke-hain-koun-1994: When Prem (Salman Khan) falls for Nisha (Madhuri Dixit), the younger sister of his brother's wife, their romance unfolds through a string of family celebrations, until tragedy tests how far each is willing to sacrifice for the family.
devdas-2002: Devdas (Shah Rukh Khan) returns from London to his childhood love Paro (Aishwarya Rai), but his family refuses the match. Heartbroken, he turns to drink and to the courtesan Chandramukhi (Madhuri Dixit). Sanjay Leela Bhansali's lavish take on the classic novel.
jodhaa-akbar-2008: The Mughal emperor Akbar (Hrithik Roshan) enters a political marriage with the Rajput princess Jodhaa (Aishwarya Rai), and has to earn her love and respect as he tries to unite an empire.
zindagi-na-milegi-dobara-2011: Three childhood friends (Hrithik Roshan, Farhan Akhtar and Abhay Deol) take a bachelor road trip across Spain, each picking one adventure the others must face. Along the way they confront what is holding them back.
gully-boy-2019: Murad (Ranveer Singh), a young man from Mumbai's Dharavi, finds his voice in street rap. Pulled between his family's expectations and his music, he writes his way out with the help of the rapper MC Sher (Siddhant Chaturvedi).
nayakan-1987: Velu (Kamal Haasan) arrives in Bombay as a boy and grows up to become a gangster and protector of the slum where he lives. Mani Ratnam's crime saga follows his rise and the cost to his family.
anbe-sivam-2003: Stranded together after a flood, a self-absorbed advertising man (R. Madhavan) and a scarred, kind-hearted social worker (Kamal Haasan) make a long journey back to Chennai, and the older man's past slowly comes to light.
enthiran-2010: Scientist Vaseegaran (Rajinikanth) builds an advanced humanoid robot, Chitti, in his own image. When Chitti develops emotions and falls for his creator's fiancée Sana (Aishwarya Rai), things go badly wrong.
bombay-1995: A Hindu journalist (Arvind Swamy) and a Muslim woman (Manisha Koirala) marry against their families' wishes and build a life in Bombay, until the riots of 1992–93 tear the city apart. Mani Ratnam's drama.
manichitrathazhu-1993: When a young couple moves into an old family mansion said to be haunted, strange events follow, and a psychiatrist (Mohanlal) is called in to find the truth behind them. A Malayalam classic of psychological suspense.
om-shanti-om-2007: Om Prakash (Shah Rukh Khan), a junior artist in 1970s Bombay, dies trying to save the star he adores. Reborn thirty years later as a film star himself, he sets out to avenge her. A tribute to Hindi cinema by Farah Khan.
bajrangi-bhaijaan-2015: Pawan (Salman Khan), a devout and simple man, finds a mute six-year-old girl who has been separated from her mother and turns out to be from Pakistan. With no papers, he sets out to take her home himself.
sultan-2016: Sultan (Salman Khan), a once-great wrestler from Haryana who lost everything, including his wife Aarfa (Anushka Sharma), returns to the ring for a mixed martial arts league to fight for his self-respect.
munna-bhai-m-b-b-s-2003: To satisfy his father, Mumbai gangster Munna Bhai (Sanjay Dutt) and his sidekick Circuit (Arshad Warsi) muscle their way into medical college, where Munna's unorthodox kindness turns the place upside down.
lage-raho-munna-bhai-2006: Trying to impress a radio host, Munna Bhai (Sanjay Dutt) starts studying Mahatma Gandhi, and soon sees Gandhi in person, giving him advice. With Circuit's help, he begins solving people's problems the Gandhian way.
rangeela-1995: Mili (Urmila Matondkar), a chorus dancer dreaming of stardom, is caught between her loyal street-smart friend Munna (Aamir Khan) and the film star Raj (Jackie Shroff) who gives her a break.
kaho-naa-pyaar-hai-2000: Rohit (Hrithik Roshan), a struggling singer, and Sonia (Ameesha Patel) fall in love, until he witnesses a murder and is killed. In New Zealand, Sonia meets a man who looks exactly like him. The film that launched Hrithik Roshan.
koi-mil-gaya-2003: Rohit (Hrithik Roshan), a young man with a developmental disability, accidentally summons an alien with his late father's computer. The creature, Jaadu, gives him extraordinary abilities and changes his life.
krrish-2006: Krishna (Hrithik Roshan), who inherited extraordinary powers from his father, follows the woman he loves (Priyanka Chopra) to Singapore, where he takes on a masked identity to stop a scientist with dangerous plans.
dhoom-2-2006: A master thief (Hrithik Roshan) pulls off spectacular heists across the world, with ACP Jai Dixit (Abhishek Bachchan) and Ali (Uday Chopra) on his tail. A thief (Aishwarya Rai) joins the chase on both sides.
war-2019: Khalid (Tiger Shroff), an Indian agent, is sent to hunt down his mentor Kabir (Hrithik Roshan), who appears to have gone rogue. The chase spans continents as Khalid tries to understand what Kabir is really doing.
raazi-2018: In 1971, Sehmat (Alia Bhatt), a young Kashmiri woman, is married into a Pakistani military family to spy for India. Based on a novel inspired by real events, it follows what the mission costs her.
highway-2014: Veera (Alia Bhatt), a young woman days away from her wedding, is kidnapped by Mahabir (Randeep Hooda). On the long road across north India, she finds a freedom she never had at home.
kapoor-and-sons-2016: Two estranged brothers (Sidharth Malhotra and Fawad Khan) return home when their grandfather falls ill, and their family's quarrels, secrets and old wounds come to the surface.
pathaan-2023: Pathaan (Shah Rukh Khan), an Indian spy brought back from exile, races to stop a former agent (John Abraham) who is plotting a devastating attack on India. Part of the YRF spy universe.
jawan-2023: Azad (Shah Rukh Khan), a jailer leading a team of women on a mission, hijacks a Mumbai metro train to force the government to act against corruption and a ruthless arms dealer (Vijay Sethupathi).
animal-2023: Ranvijay (Ranbir Kapoor), desperate for his distant father's love, turns to violent revenge after an attempt on his father's life. A dark family drama by Sandeep Reddy Vanga.
eega-2012: Nani, a young man murdered by a powerful businessman (Sudeep) who covets the woman he loves, is reborn as a housefly, and sets out to take revenge and protect her. S. S. Rajamouli's fantasy.
pokiri-2006: Pandu (Mahesh Babu), a brash Hyderabad goon who will take any job for money, gets caught between two crime gangs and a corrupt cop, while falling for a fitness trainer (Ileana D'Cruz). Puri Jagannadh's action hit.
athadu-2005: Nandu (Mahesh Babu), a hired assassin framed for a politician's murder, escapes and takes refuge in a village by posing as a family's long-lost son. Trivikram Srinivas's action thriller.
ghilli-2004: Velu (Vijay), a kabaddi player from Chennai, rescues a girl (Trisha) from a violent factionist who wants to marry her by force, and has to hide her in his own home. A remake of the Telugu film Okkadu.
mersal-2017: A doctor famous for treating patients for five rupees becomes the suspect in a string of disappearances of medical professionals. Vijay plays multiple roles in Atlee's drama about the business of healthcare.
leo-2023: Parthiban (Vijay), a café owner in Himachal Pradesh, becomes a local hero after fighting off gangsters, but the attention brings a crime family who believe he is someone else. Part of Lokesh Kanagaraj's cinematic universe.
asuran-2019: Sivasaamy (Dhanush), a farmer in a caste-divided village, tries to protect his young son after the boy kills a powerful landlord, and his own violent past comes back. Vetrimaaran's drama, adapted from the novel Vekkai.
super-deluxe-2019: Four stories intersect over a single day in Chennai: a couple with a dead body, a father who returns home as a trans woman, teenagers with a stolen TV, and a woman who survived a tsunami and found faith.
vada-chennai-2018: Anbu (Dhanush), a carrom player from North Chennai, is drawn into the gang wars of his neighbourhood, and into a story of loyalty and betrayal stretching back decades. Vetrimaaran's crime saga.
lucifer-2019: After the death of a powerful Kerala politician, a struggle for control of his party begins, and the mysterious Stephen Nedumpally (Mohanlal) moves to protect it from his enemies. Prithviraj Sukumaran's first film as director.
agneepath-1990: Vijay Deenanath Chauhan (Amitabh Bachchan) grows up vowing revenge on the gangster who lynched his father, a village schoolteacher, and becomes a feared don in Bombay to get it.
agneepath-2012: Twelve-year-old Vijay watches the drug lord Kancha (Sanjay Dutt) kill his father in their island village. Years later in Mumbai, he rises in the underworld (Hrithik Roshan) to take his revenge. A remake of the 1990 film.
anand-1971: Anand (Rajesh Khanna), a cheerful man with a terminal illness, decides to live his remaining days to the full, and changes the life of his reserved doctor (Amitabh Bachchan) along the way. Hrishikesh Mukherjee's classic.
don-1978: When the gangster Don (Amitabh Bachchan) dies, the police replace him with Vijay, a lookalike street performer, to bring down the gang from inside, but the plan goes wrong when the only person who knows the truth is killed.
amar-akbar-anthony-1977: Three brothers separated as children are raised in three different faiths: Amar (Vinod Khanna) becomes a police officer, Akbar (Rishi Kapoor) a qawwali singer and Anthony (Amitabh Bachchan) a bootlegger. Manmohan Desai's family entertainer.
silsila-1981: Amit (Amitabh Bachchan) and Chandni (Rekha) are in love, but fate pushes both into marriages with other people. Years later their paths cross again. Yash Chopra's romantic drama.
kabhi-kabhie-1976: A poet (Amitabh Bachchan) and the woman he loves (Raakhee) are married to others, and their lives cross again years later, through their children. Yash Chopra's drama of love across two generations.
black-2005: Michelle (Rani Mukerji), deaf and blind since childhood, lives in darkness until an eccentric teacher (Amitabh Bachchan) breaks through to her. Years later she returns the favour when he is losing his memory.
paa-2009: Auro (Amitabh Bachchan), a bright 12-year-old with progeria, a disease that ages him rapidly, befriends a young politician (Abhishek Bachchan) without knowing he is his father.
piku-2015: Piku (Deepika Padukone), an architect in Delhi, looks after her cantankerous, health-obsessed father (Amitabh Bachchan). A road trip to their family home in Kolkata with a reluctant taxi-company owner (Irrfan Khan) tests all three.
andhadhun-2018: Akash (Ayushmann Khurrana), a pianist pretending to be blind, walks into a private performance at an apartment and finds himself the 'blind' witness to a murder. Sriram Raghavan's dark thriller.
gangs-of-wasseypur-2012: A blood feud between two families plays out over decades in the coal town of Wasseypur, from Sardar Khan (Manoj Bajpayee) to his son Faizal (Nawazuddin Siddiqui). Anurag Kashyap's crime saga.
dil-chahta-hai-2001: Three close friends just out of college (Aamir Khan, Saif Ali Khan and Akshaye Khanna) drift apart as love and growing up pull them in different directions. Farhan Akhtar's first film.
dil-se-1998: A radio journalist (Shah Rukh Khan) becomes obsessed with a mysterious woman (Manisha Koirala) he meets in Assam, unaware that she is part of a militant group. Mani Ratnam's romantic drama.
kal-ho-naa-ho-2003: Aman (Shah Rukh Khan), a cheerful newcomer to New York, transforms the life of his gloomy neighbour Naina (Preity Zinta) and her family, even as he hides a secret that keeps him from loving her back.
chennai-express-2013: Rahul (Shah Rukh Khan) boards a train to carry his grandfather's ashes south, and helps Meena (Deepika Padukone), the daughter of a powerful don, escape a forced marriage. An action comedy by Rohit Shetty.
my-name-is-khan-2010: Rizwan Khan (Shah Rukh Khan), a Muslim man with Asperger's syndrome, sets out across America to meet the President after the September 11 attacks shatter his family.
rab-ne-bana-di-jodi-2008: Surinder (Shah Rukh Khan), a shy Punjab clerk, marries the lively Taani (Anushka Sharma) after a tragedy. Unable to win her heart as himself, he reinvents himself as the flamboyant Raj.
gadar-ek-prem-katha-2001: During Partition, Tara Singh (Sunny Deol), a Sikh truck driver, saves and marries Sakeena (Ameesha Patel), a Muslim girl. When she is taken to Pakistan, he crosses the border to bring her back.
border-1997: Based on the 1971 Battle of Longewala, a small company of Indian soldiers holds a border post in Rajasthan through the night against a Pakistani tank attack. J. P. Dutta's war film.
sita-ramam-2022: In 1964, Ram (Dulquer Salmaan), an army officer, receives letters from a woman named Sita (Mrunal Thakur). Twenty years later, a student is asked to deliver a letter he left behind, and uncovers their love story.
stree-2-2024: Chanderi is safe from Stree, but a new headless terror is taking women from the town. Vicky (Rajkummar Rao) and his friends team up again to stop it. A horror comedy sequel.
fighter-2024: Squadron Leader Shamsher Pathania (Hrithik Roshan) joins an elite air force unit set up to respond to terror attacks. The team, led by Rakesh Jai Singh (Anil Kapoor), faces its biggest test after an attack in Kashmir.
vikram-vedha-2022: Vikram (Saif Ali Khan), an encounter specialist, hunts the gangster Vedha (Hrithik Roshan), who surrenders and tells him stories that make him question right and wrong. Remake of the 2017 Tamil film.
